scope: Read-only source audit by C during concurrent A/B implementation; no new build or runtime executed by C

findings.location: GameEngine.NamedAmbush.cs CleanupLostNamedAmbushPiles / LiveAmbushDeposits; GameEngine.RuleProgression.cs both rule entries
findings.conclusion: With catalog capability present, every cleanup does one full history array and Removed hash set per player even with no physical private persistent cards.
findings.proposed: Current-zone nonempty fast gate globally and per owner; never gate on enabled live skill because genuine source loss must still clean up existing cards.

findings.evidence: static concrete call chain; runtime regression not yet executed
findings.conclusion: For two lost-source deposits, outer ToArray includes both; moving the first enters RecordMovement -> AdvanceEventRulesAndQueueFact -> Cleanup, which moves remaining live cards. The outer loop then attempts a second move from the old location.
findings.proposed: Recheck each exact entity/deposit before its move or use an atomic same-pile movement with exact per-deposit facts; preserve true movement batches and observer children.

findings.conclusion: Cleanup checks raw SkillGrants.Grants identity, not qualified HasRuntimeSkillInstance. Current-turn suppression therefore disables offer without deleting a still-owned pile; real removal or death qualifies cleanup.

findings.evidence: static behavior plus rule interpretation; no official combo FAQ or runtime death proof
findings.conclusion: CanContinueNamedAmbush admits exact paid movement after owner death, but ReturnNamedAmbushMovement currently skips invalidation when owner is dead. Existing source-loss fixture recovers owner and removes skill, so it does not prove this death behavior.
findings.proposed: Resolve intended paid-effect behavior explicitly and exercise an actual non-Lord owner death in a real movement child without ending the game.

findings.conclusion: Pile projection gates entries by viewer owner/revealAll; Freeze clones outer and nested entry lists; WPF re-gates by HumanSeat and ignores unauthorized foreign DTO entries. Paid invalidation is attached to exact native CardUseFrame or typed Dodge/Nullification owner, with real movement and deposited/removed fact proof. In-progress runtime filters remain required.

findings.evidence: static read plus owner-reported focused progress
findings.conclusion: Meibu issued payment may continue after donor loss/death for a living recipient; Mumu dead beneficiary finishes without new ban. Restrictions use actual phase ledger and dynamic HP. B has focused cases for private wrong actor, paid source loss/death, grant children cold return, plain virtual use, true counterspell use and played Slash exclusion.
